yt_description:
Get ready to be amazed! 🤩 We're diving deep into the Comb Sort algorithm, a clever sorting method that tackles the 'turtles' (small elements at the end) and 'rabbits' (large elements at the beginning) that plague other algorithms like Bubble Sort. 🚀 Watch as we visualize its elegant dance and understand WHY it's so efficient!  

In this video, you'll discover:
✅ How Comb Sort works, step-by-step
✅ Its surprising speed and efficiency compared to other sorts
✅ The secret to its shrinking gap
✅ Practical applications and when to use it
